content:
GreenLeaf Organic Foods Pvt Ltd, operating through GreenLeaf Farms and GreenLeaf Retail LLP across organic food retail and the agri supply chain, processes personal data at multiple touchpoints: farmer and FPO identifiers, land and produce records, supplier and logistics-partner details, retail customer profiles linked to loyalty and delivery data, employee and field-staff records, and digital-channel information such as app activity, CCTV footage and payment references. Farm aggregation and certification programs further generate location-linked and traceability records that can identify individual growers, while retail analytics and e-commerce platforms extend processing to consumer behaviour.

Under the DPDP Act, 2023, this data would be assessed for lawful notice and consent, purpose limitation, data minimisation, and cross-entity sharing between the two subsidiaries. Key assessment focus areas include classifying farmer and retailer data as personal data, validating consent managers and deeming-consent grounds, evaluating Significant Data Fiduciary exposure through volume and tracking technology, strengthening breach notification readiness, and ensuring standalone compliance by GreenLeaf Retail LLP alongside group-level governance mechanisms.
